title: Scalar pull and push comparisons are the specified adjoint mates
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite normed field extension, put $A=\mathcal O_E$ and fix a uniformizer $\varpi$. Let $k$ have positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$, and let all schemes mentioned be separated and of finite type over $k$. Require explicitly that each scheme is Noetherian and finite dimensional and that $\ell$ is invertible in its local rings. On the small pro-etale site put $A_T=\varprojlim_n(A/\varpi^n)_T$ and $E_T(V)=C(|V|,E)$, with pointwise operations; regard $E_T$ as an $A_T$-algebra through the canonical isomorphism $A_T\cong(V\mapsto C(|V|,A))$ of [lem-weil-pbc-continuous-coefficients-immersion-restriction] followed by postcomposition with the inclusion $A\subset E$. Use the integral category $\mathcal I_T=\Dbc(T,A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and its raw scalar localization $\mathcal R_T=\mathcal I_T[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Let $h:T\to U$ be any $k$-morphism, let $F_T,F_U$ be the ambient scalar extensions of [lem-weil-pbc-realization-scalar-functor], and put $P_h=Lh^*_{\mathrm{comp}}$ and $Q_h=Rh_{*,A}$ on integral constructible objects. Their adjunction uses the inverse of the actual completion unit to identify $P_h$ with ordinary pullback [lem-weil-pbc-realization-completed-pull]. Put $P_h^E=Lh_c^*$ and $Q_h^E=Rh_{c,*}$ with their ambient adjunction [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For the specified comparisons $\alpha:F_TP_h\simeq P_h^EF_U$ and $\beta:F_UQ_h\simeq Q_h^EF_T$ of [lem-weil-pbc-realization-completed-pull] and [lem-weil-pbc-realization-localized-push], the direct-image comparison is the right adjoint mate of the pullback comparison. Explicitly, for integral $N$ on $U$ and $M$ on $T$,
$$Q_h^E(\alpha_N)\,\beta_{P_hN}\,F_U(\eta_N)=\eta^E_{F_UN},\qquad F_T(\epsilon_M)=\epsilon^E_{F_TM}\,P_h^E(\beta_M)\,\alpha_{Q_hM}.$$
Here $\eta,\epsilon$ and $\eta^E,\epsilon^E$ are the respective units and counits, and compositions are read right to left. These equations persist for the localized adjunctions of [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport].

proof.text: The integral coefficient isomorphism is fixed by its hom being the completed coefficient map. The rational one is fixed by its inverse-image adjunction transpose: its sections are precomposition, and evaluation detects equality. Substitute these equalities in the arbitrary supplied push datum. Restrict the ambient actual derived adjunction to the two integral full subcategories, and transport its left adjoint along the actual strict-completion-unit isomorphism. The Hom transpose is therefore exactly precomposition with that unit, followed by the ambient Hom transpose.

Use realization-restriction-normalizations for the supplied pull datum. Its pull and ambient counit equations use precisely the actual coefficient maps. For the arbitrary push datum, use its own beta_normalization field, which is the scalar-adjunction transpose equation. Apply scalarNormalizedAdjunctionSquare to these equations. The ordinary alpha is scalar extension of the actual completion unit followed by the specified completed alpha. The restricted ordinary unit and counit are the ambient components. Naturality of beta at the completion unit, and cancellation of that unit with its inverse, give the completed unit equation; precomposing the ordinary counit equation by scalar extension of the inverse unit gives the completed counit equation.

Use actual direct-image constant-scalar linearity and restriction to obtain the additive and linear structures on the specified integral push. The existing rational-descent helpers identify raw rationalization as a categorical localization and give the identity-component comparison between tensor transport and rationalization. Apply Mathlib Adjunction.localization to the completed adjunction with these comparisons; its unit and counit formulas reduce to rationalization of the integral components. Conjugate integral alpha and beta by the specified integral scalar comparisons and descend the resulting natural isomorphisms using fully faithful precomposition along rationalization. On each unchanged raw object their components have exactly the formulas stated in the conclusion. Substitute these formulas into the rational unit and counit equations; naturality of the scalar comparisons and of the continuous unit and counit cancels the intervening comparison inverses and reduces to the integral equations. This gives the specified rational functors directly, without an existential replacement of those functors.
